decisions.reason: As a close-to-core upholstery fabric with a dedicated page and another year of survival, it remains a low-cost, credible option whose continued presence is more valuable than abandoning it now.

We would keep this adjacent decorative fabric because it still fits the range and is cheap to carry, but its limited website prominence after two seasons leaves it under clear review for possible pruning.
After another year, this niche wool-blend decoration fabric still looks more peripheral and less scalable than our stronger options, so the option value no longer justifies keeping it in the line.
This newly launched, versatile upholstery-and-curtain fabric has its own page and sits squarely in our core business, so uncertainty is still too high and exit costs too unnecessary to drop it yet.
